title: Solve Linear Inequalities: Boundary and Test
description: Solve linear inequalities in one variable and test values or ordered pairs in inequalities with two variables.

questions.stem_html: Which choice gives the complete solution set of \(3x+6\le 33\)?
questions.explanation_html: Equality puts the boundary at x = 9. The positive coefficient preserves the direction. Include the boundary.

distractor_notes.B: Uses the wrong side of the boundary.

questions.stem_html: What is the least integer x that satisfies \(4x-5>21\)?

questions.explanation_html: Substitute x = 4 and y = 1. The left side is 11, which is at least 11.

questions.stem_html: The line \(y=2x+3\) divides the plane. Which region is the full solution set of \(y\le 2x+3\)?
questions.explanation_html: At each x, compare y with the boundary’s height. The requested values are lower. Equality is allowed.
questions.variation: Identify the winning region and its boundary
choices: The region below the line, excluding the line
The region below the line, including the line
The region above the line, including the line
